{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
total_rows = len(data)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA orders percentage: {len(qa_orders) / total_rows * 100:.1f}%')"}
